scope: Canonical move iteration and deterministic tie-breaking at roster selection cutoffs in team, threat, and move-record features.
cause: Unordered move sets changed floating-point posterior accumulation; near-tied top-three roster choices could change substantially.
validation: Rerun all compared model families on the same three grouped CV partitions; check features and final inference across different Python hash seeds.
prior_results: The earlier study metrics and CSV precede this fix and remain historical artifacts, not the final branch result.
additional_cause: Read access to defaultdict(set) inserted empty move observations. Full fitting differed according to whether baseline features came from a cache.
additional_fix: Use plain observed-move maps, non-mutating get calls, and exclude empty evidence from learned move-prior populations.
